collection.title: Data Collection
collection.content: We collect information such as your email address, name, and academic data (major, year) to provide and improve our services.

usage.title: Data Usage
usage.content: Your data is used to personalize your experience, facilitate academic communication, and send you important updates.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: We use cookies to improve navigation, remember your preferences, and analyze site traffic.

security.title: Security
security.content: We implement state-of-the-art security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time through your account settings.

usage.content: Permission is granted to temporarily download one copy of the materials (information or software) on EMsee's website for personal, non-commercial transitory viewing only.

content.content: You retain your rights to any content you submit, post or display on or through the Services. You are responsible for your use of the Services and for any Content you provide.

termination.content: We may terminate or suspend your access immediately, without prior notice or liability, for any reason whatsoever, including without limitation if you breach the Terms.

about_page.title: About EMsee
about_page.description: EMsee is more than just a social network. It is a digital space designed specifically for EMSI students, allowing them to connect, share, and grow together.
about_page.mission_desc: To facilitate student life by centralizing communication and mutual aid tools. We believe in the strength of the community to succeed in studies.
about_page.team_desc: A project made with passion by students, for students.
